title: Authority map: evidence, assessment, policy and execution stay separate
summary: The stack is intentionally layered so that no semantic capture object acquires downstream legal, causal, institutional-policy or execution authority merely by carrying evidence.
invariants: Structured Utterance records generation-time structure; it does not decide legality or morality.
Interaction Event records rich evidence and assessments; assessments remain assessments and candidate causal links remain unproven.
Brand Interaction Effect evaluates brand/commercial significance and scoped association; it does not become Legal Effect or causal authority.
Brand Intervention emits non-executable reasoning guidance; Effectiveness measures observed association; Governance emits review dispositions.
Institutional Policy selects the operative reviewed governance rule artefact; Brand Governance owns domain meaning; named domain authority remains separate; execution remains external.

provenance.claim: Interaction Event invariants keep assessments, causality and downstream domains separate.
Institutional Policy selection authority, Brand governance semantics, named authority and execution remain separate.
